0022600217.text: The Pacers host the Washington Wizards at 3-8, sitting 11th in the East and 4.5 games back in the Central, with a 0-5 home record and a 2-8 mark over their last ten games, including a two-game losing streak. The Wizards arrive at 4-7, 10th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Southeast, on a four-game losing streak after going 3-7 over their last ten. Pacers Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain) are out, and T.J. McConnell (hamstring) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost the season series 1-3, including a 131-118 loss in Washington on February 20, 2026.
